## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short single-fascicle (1卷) **abridged sectional-outline** (*lüèkē* 略科) for [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85)'s *Tōngyì* ([KR6j0687](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0687)). Together with the *Xuánjìng* ([KR6j0685](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0685)) it forms the prefatory apparatus to the main commentary, in the three-part *xuánshì + kē + shū* structure standard for late-Míng *Lèngyán* commentaries (cf. [KR6j0681](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0681) / [KR6j0682](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0682) / [KR6j0683](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0683)). Preserved as **X12 no. 278** in the *Xùzàngjīng*.

**Abstract**

The work introduces a **notational-symbol system** (*biāokē lìhàojì* 標科立號記) for cross-referencing between the outline and the commentary — a remarkably modern editorial apparatus for a Míng exegetical text. The dating bracket is set to **1597 – 1623**, corresponding to Hānshān's Wànlì-era period of intensive *Lèngyán* study following the *Xuánjìng* and ending at his death.
